comparison.objective: Candidate removes a connector terminal; record refits and pull-tests a loaded drawer on roller slides.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine tool insertion and coordinated wire withdrawal versus bimanual load carrying, hook clearance, rail engagement, closing, and reopening.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires selective intact depinning with unmeasured force/damage bounds. Record checks drawer height, level, squareness, centering, closed pose, pull-test reopening, and hands-off state.
comparison.reason: The rigid insertion/alignment sequence and load handling are unrelated to latch-mediated terminal extraction.
